reference.rationale: Fixed before any GPU result: several bf16 roundings, approximate elementary functions and bf16 saved states. Elementwise tolerance AND relative L2 cap required. Must first pass official tied-baseline calibration on the same fixture/dtype for each architecture; triple is INCONCLUSIVE if baseline calibration fails. These caps are never fitted to triple errors or relaxed after failure.

reference.reference_dtype: fp32 on exactly quantized kernel input values; no claim of fp32 kernel execution
